judgments.en_span: Completion is conditional upon the fulfilment of the following Conditions: (a) the Vendor having delivered to the Company the audited financial statements of the Target for the year ended 31 December 2025, and there having been no material adverse change in the business, assets or financial position of the Target since 30 June 2026.
judgments.zh_span: 完成須待下列條件達成後，方可作實：(a) 賣方已向本公司交付目標公司截至二零二五年十二月三十一日止年度的經審核財務報表，且目標公司的業務、資產或財務狀況自二零二六年六月三十日以來並無重大不利變動；
judgments.explanation: Both passages convey the same conditional requirement for completion with identical substantive conditions.

judgments.en_span: (b) the Vendor having obtained all necessary third-party consents in respect of the Acquisition.
judgments.zh_span: (b) 賣方已就收購事項取得所有必要的第三方同意；
judgments.explanation: Both passages express the same condition regarding third-party consents using glossary-defined terms.

judgments.en_span: (d) the warranties given by the Vendor under the Agreement remaining true, accurate and not misleading in all material respects as at Completion.
judgments.zh_span: (c) 賣方根據本協議作出的保證於完成時在所有重大方面仍屬真實、準確且無誤導成分。
judgments.explanation: EN lists this as condition (d) while ZH lists it as condition (c), indicating a different numbering/ordering of conditions.

judgments.en_span: The Company may waive the Condition relating to the warranties given by the Vendor at its sole discretion.
judgments.zh_span: 本公司可全權酌情豁免有關賣方所作保證的條件。
judgments.explanation: Both passages convey the same discretionary waiver right using glossary-defined terms.

judgments.en_span: None of the other Conditions may be waived.
judgments.zh_span: 其他條件概不可獲豁免。
judgments.explanation: Both passages express the same prohibition on waiving other conditions.

judgments.en_span: As at the date of this announcement, none of the Conditions has been fulfilled.
judgments.zh_span: 於本公告日期，概無條件已獲達成。
judgments.explanation: Both passages state that no conditions have been fulfilled as of the announcement date.

judgments.en_span: If the Conditions are not fulfilled on or before 31 December 2026 (the "Long Stop Date"), the Agreement shall lapse.
judgments.zh_span: 倘條件未能於二零二六年十一月三十日（「最後截止日期」）或之前達成，本協議將告失效。
judgments.explanation: EN specifies 31 December 2026 as the Long Stop Date, while ZH specifies 30 November 2026, creating a material date discrepancy.

judgments.en_span: Upon the Agreement lapsing, neither party shall have any claim against the other save for any antecedent breach.
judgments.zh_span: 本協議失效後，任何一方概無權向另一方提出任何申索，惟先前的違約除外。
judgments.explanation: Both passages convey the same consequence of agreement lapse with identical carve-out for prior breaches.
